newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak gas SPP sees higher 1996 net profit.
newsitem.headline: Slovak gas SPP sees higher 1996 net profit.

text.p: Slovak state monopoly gas distributor Slovensky Plynarensky Priemysel (SPP) s.p. on Monday said, according to preliminary figures, it expected a net profit of 8.862 billion crowns in 1996.
SPP recorded a net profit of 6.467 billion crowns in 1995.
"We expect officially-approved results in the beginning of February," the SPP's spokesman Lubomir Rabay told Reuters.

The company's main profits are derived from the transit natural gas pipeline from Russia to western Europe. The pipeline, which began operation in April 1971, serves about 10 consumers in central and western Europe.
Rabay said SPP saw revenues from sales of natural gas exceed forecasts by some 458.8 million crowns. He added SPP also expected higher revenues from sales of the services, mainly from transit fees.
The increase in the revenues from transit fees was caused mainly by the increase of amount of transported natural gas to the Czech Republic, Rabay said.
Note. All figures in Slovak crowns. Figures from 1996 are preliminary.
